checks: response, worker cycle and check separately shown
check cost matches recorded block mean
HTTP and database spans both visible
uncovered window not called CPU time
replacement-only case has no sleep calibration
projection not presented as full-response equality
real API replacement has no timer calibration
actual per-site invocation and block totals
bundle effect not allocated by counts
legacy unambiguous single-site total can be assigned
request count not substituted for blocks
large effect with insufficient resolution not promoted
sampled block selector with replay fixture
legacy check cost not assumed zero
